PALM Windows 64-bit Vamp plugin bundle

Components: QM Key Detector, QM Bar and Beat Tracker (qm-vamp-plugins),
Chordino and NNLS-Chroma (nnls-chroma), with the Vamp Plugin SDK.
Version: 1.0.0
Copyright: Queen Mary University of London; Matthias Mauch and contributors.
Licence: GPL-2.0-or-later. Full text:
licenses/third_party/licenses/GPL-2.0-or-later.txt

Built in PALM's Windows CI from pinned upstream source commits using MSVC
(QM plugin) and MinGW-w64 x64 (Chordino). The bundle contains the two plugin
DLLs, their catalogs and the upstream licence texts. It is downloaded by
setup into <data>/tools/vamp-plugins and is never committed or bundled in the
PALM installer/ZIP/DMG.

Source repositories:
  https://github.com/c4dm/qm-vamp-plugins
  https://github.com/c4dm/qm-dsp
  https://github.com/c4dm/nnls-chroma
  https://github.com/vamp-plugins/vamp-plugin-sdk
Release:
  https://github.com/ThomasTZh/PALM-Practice-Any-Local-Music/releases/tag/plugins-win64-v1
SHA-256:
  41475f374966a3d2126c84e0d434fbc774738e427c01b5aeccfd025dfc143863
